messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000835": As of 2025-11-06, Marcus holds the pager rotation for the Boreal team, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000829": As of 2025-11-06, Marcus has the Boreal team on-call shift, taking over from Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000817" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team, having moved from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000808": On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000780" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000767": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000759": On 2025-09-23 the Dune team noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000678": As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000640": As of 2025-08-15, the Boreal team still owns the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000582": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000564": As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service remains owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000416": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus, Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team, notification service, Cinder, ledger service, Dune team, the bus, reporting service, Tomasz, Farah, Priya Raman, billing API, indexer, webhook dispatcher, notifier, INC-2025-004

The note:

[2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
